rounds.notes:
Round 2. Pickup the very important [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be)

Our other pickup, assuming we have atleast $8000 total is  [High Capacity Tubing](item_d4779a06-a19c-425d-80ff-159fde15a3f2). While we are still in early rounds, ability power and orb usefulness is lower. Picking up HCT allows our primary weapon to be more impactful until we have enough money to transition to full orbs in Round 3.

Any extra money can be spent on green +Ability Power +Weapon Power and/or Increase Health/Armor/Shields depending on your observations from Round 1.

rounds.notes:
Round 4. Money available = $24000-$33000

The above is becoming a large range. The focus here is to start boosting you ability power while also lowering your cooldowns.  

Choose what is best for your money range. Optional items have been provided to choose from.

[Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) and [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) are my favorite for this round. Highly recommended if you have $30500.

 [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) only for $26000.

 [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) is only $4000 if you are $500 short of purchasing [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) 

For low low budgets remember Round 3 notes, you can get +25 ability power and +20 weapon power with 1 node left open for $14000. Adding [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6) gets you to +45 ability power for $20000. Though this is the last option and the cheapest, it is still very strong for Round 4.

Season 18 Update:
If you are having an issue vs an enemy who keeps diving you and are not getting help from your team, lifesteal works well with Moira. Ability Lifesteal also works with heal orb in addition to damage orb. Your Biotic grasp (primary right click) will also benefit from weapon lifesteal. If you do not invest into Health/Armor/Shields, I'd recommend Lifesteal.  [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318)  [Shady Spectacles](item_ef9bb72f-a56c-4fb6-a552-5abce0b943d7) [Vitality Amplifier](item_6b52b1c9-a924-4a93-8545-a1c205cf6927) [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643)

rounds.notes:
Round 5. Available money $31000-$43000

(Again these are estimations based on lower performing round of around $7000 and better performing rounds of $10000)

Goal of this round:
New power = More overall healing with either power selection (see below).
Items = Lower Cooldowns and/or add Debuffs if you already took the cooldown abilities last round.

Power: 
 [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d) is taken. It enables us to create another orb where we could not before. Orbs are already boosted giving us even more healing and orb uptime.
 [Precarious Potency](item_b1305ee6-3027-4131-8797-dcbeb68e3953) is very strong.  It boosts the flat 81 healing per second (hps) of your primary to 101 with +0 weapon power. It also boosts your 3 sec heal over time from 17 hps to 37 for the first 3 seconds then 20 for 2 more seconds after. Any boost in weapon damage will increase these values.

Items:
 [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505)
 [Biotech Maximizer](item_01c6dcb3-d2e2-4c57-bd21-61d7b8f939c4) 
 [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) 
 [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) 

Season 18 Update: After many round of playing I found getting cooldowns and the 1 healing debuff is better to do first.  [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98) is a great ability but is a lower overall healing output to take early and its benefits are limited depending on who you are fighting against.

rounds.notes:
Round 7. Your last power depends on if you want more orbs or more healing from your primary. Both at this point are viable.

Keep a minimum of 15% cooldown reduction to keep up with the power scaling for the last round. Enemies will be dealing a lot of damage, you need orbs available ASAP.

95 AP with  [Champion's Kit](item_8682f8c7-8811-439b-8d50-fa81cd43ddce) if you have enough money to drop [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) or [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) 

My favorite end game Round 7 setup is:
 [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be) 
 [Extendrils](item_138e73a2-6915-4ffc-bd89-029a85bf94b8)

 [Vanadium Injection](item_57953fbc-11ff-4e92-9928-fc59b7be668f) 

I take [Vanadium Injection](item_57953fbc-11ff-4e92-9928-fc59b7be668f) over [Champion's Kit](item_8682f8c7-8811-439b-8d50-fa81cd43ddce) for versatility. I find myself losing value in late rounds when using my ult over continuing the never ending spam of orbs. It is also hard to see clearly in 3rd person when using your ult as Moira. 100 more effective health, and 10% to every stat is very strong.
